purpose: Public-safe reconciliation register for candidate research projects considered for onboarding into the Research Command Center.
policy: Candidate reconciliation does not create a public project record. Promotion requires canonical identity, controlled status, public-safe lifecycle classification, and zero blocking validation errors.

candidates.label: NCD evidence synthesis research
candidates.reason: Multiple files identify themselves as final research reports but use materially different project titles and scopes. A canonical final version must be selected before the project can be classified as Completed.
candidates.nextGate: Resolve canonical final title, scope, and version; then bind the selected version to a controlled project identity before public onboarding.

candidates.label: Digital health behavior profiling of university students
candidates.reason: A research proposal is available, but no authoritative or controlled research binding was verified and proposal existence alone is insufficient to promote the work to an active governed project.
candidates.nextGate: Verify a controlled candidate or active-project record and confirm current lifecycle status.

candidates.label: MOVE24 research program
candidates.reason: No separate authoritative binding was verified that safely distinguishes MOVE24 from the governed BMO research identity. The projects must not be conflated.
candidates.nextGate: Establish whether MOVE24 is a separate project, a predecessor, or a related workstream, and verify its authoritative identity before onboarding.
